sections.content: között (between) works the same way as the other postpositions but needs two things to sit between, joined with és (and): X és Y között.

items.spanish: A szék a kanapé és az asztal között van.
items.english: The chair is between the sofa and the table.

sections.content: közötte would be wrong here — között stays in its plain form after the és-joined pair; nothing gets attached to it just because two nouns came before it.
